# The Seattle Times

> > Award-winning news organization covering Seattle, Washington, and the Pacific Northwest with Pulitzer Prize-winning investigative journalism, local news, sports, and community-focused reporting.

The Seattle Times is the Pacific Northwest's premier news source, featuring specialized coverage through Education Lab and Traffic Lab, comprehensive reporting on Boeing and regional business, and extensive local content including dining, demographics, and transportation. The site also offers entertainment features including crossword puzzles and comics.

## Key Topics

- Seattle news and local reporting
- Washington state coverage
- Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism
- Boeing investigations
- Education Lab (Seattle public schools)
- Traffic Lab (transportation reporting)
- Pacific Northwest regional news
- Capitol Hill neighborhood coverage
- Seattle dining and restaurants
- Seattle demographics and census data
- I-90 and Snoqualmie Pass traffic
- Seahawks and Mariners sports
- Edgar Martinez and Ichiro coverage

## Award-Winning Journalism

- [Pulitzers](https://www.seattletimes.com/pulitzers): Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism including Boeing 737 MAX investigation

## Specialized Coverage Labs

- [About Education Lab](https://www.seattletimes.com/education-lab-about): Education Lab team covering Seattle public education, Gates Foundation
- [About Traffic Lab](https://www.seattletimes.com/about-traffic-lab): Traffic Lab team covering Seattle transportation, sponsored by Alaska Air

## Local News and Information

- [Traffic](https://www.seattletimes.com/traffic): Seattle traffic updates, I-90, Snoqualmie Pass, and highway conditions
- [FYI Guy](https://www.seattletimes.com/source/fyi-guy): Seattle demographics, census data, and urban trends analysis column
- [All You Can Eat](https://www.seattletimes.com/source/all-you-can-eat): Seattle dining, restaurant openings/closings, and food news column

## Reader Resources

- [RSS Feeds](https://www.seattletimes.com/rss-feeds): RSS feed directory for Seattle Times news, sports, and columnists

## Optional

- [Games: LA Times Crossword](https://www.seattletimes.com/games-latimes-crossword): LA Times Crossword puzzle game with daily challenges
- [Comics: Universal Comics](https://www.seattletimes.com/comics-universal): Universal Comics syndicated by Andrews McMeel Syndication
- [Quads only](https://www.seattletimes.com/curation_tax/quads-only): Editorial content curation group for quads-layout homepage modules
- [Readers Lens terms and conditions](https://www.seattletimes.com/readers-lens-terms-and-conditions): Reader's Lens photo contest terms for Washington state residents
- [Sports](https://www.seattletimes.com/curation_tax/sports): Sports content curation with Edgar Martinez, Ichiro, NBA, NFL coverage
